newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion, South West holders approve merger.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion, South West holders approve merger.

text.p: United Dominion Realty Trust Inc and South West Property Trust Inc said Tuesday their shareholders approved the companies' merger -- announced October 1 -- at separate shareholder meetings.

Approval required that a majority of United Dominion's shares and two-thirds of South West's shares vote in favor of the combination. The companies said about 99 percent of the voting shares were cast in favor of the merger, expected to close December 31.
At that time, South West shareholders will receive about $312 million of United Dominion common stock -- or 1.0833 shares of United Dominion for each South West share owned.
